summary: Comprehensive frontend-only Playwright testing of Locat UI 3.0 (standalone Vite project at http://localhost:5173, React 19 + TS + Tailwind). Covered the entry flow (welcome / sign-in / register / server setup / local mode), the mobile app shell at 390 and 360, the desktop app shell at 1440, bottom nav visibility, no-horizontal-overflow checks across Home/Cinema/Music/Photos/Devices/Modules, Messages (c-mira open, composer send with 'Preview only' marker, bottom nav hidden inside conversation), Cinema (video-v1 opens player), Music (track-t1 → mini-player), Photos (photos-allow-all limited-access banner + 30 photo tiles including HEIC), Hub honest-metrics (em-dash, no fake numbers), Settings theme switch (data-theme=daylight) and logout returning to welcome, desktop sidebar nav (20 nav-* items), preview-lab-button on desktop, and the Ctrl+K command palette (command-input). Register password gate correctly keeps register-submit disabled for short passwords; server setup correctly shows the 'HTTPS required' banner for http://x; welcome-local → local-continue → tab-chats correctly shows state-offline while media stays usable. Honesty check: sign-in flow shows auth-pending-notice and no success toast is ever emitted. Overall success rate: 100% of in-app assertions passed; the only observed artefact is that the session store is not persisted across hard page reloads (page.goto resets state back to welcome), which is consistent with a preview-only build and does not affect user flows.
action_items: No action required for current scope. Optional: if end-to-end testing with URL deep-links is desired later, consider persisting the session store (zustand persist) to localStorage so that direct navigation to /messages, /photos, etc. doesn't bounce back to the Welcome screen. This is observational only — the request did not require it and in-app navigation works perfectly.
critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx cleanly lazy-loads every route, has an ErrorBoundary and a BackProvider rootPath driven by prefs.startup. Routing is coherent (49-item/ecosystem coverage matches the docs). No React Native code (correctly a React web app). testID coverage is excellent — every requested data-testid in the spec was found and functional. No HTML/JSX layout issues observed at 360, 390 or 1440. All backend-dependent flows return 'integration-pending' with the required violet preview toast and never fake success, as specified.
seed_data_creation: None. Fixture adapter in src/fixtures/previewAdapter.ts provides all preview data (c-mira, v1, t1, p0..p29, etc.).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vite dev server runs on http://localhost:5173. Sign-in with any username/password → click [data-testid=continue-demo-button] to enter app-shell. IMPORTANT: Session is in-memory only — use in-app navigation (click [data-testid=nav-*] on desktop, [data-testid=tab-*] on mobile) instead of page.goto('/path'), otherwise the session resets to Welcome. All adapter calls return integration-pending by design (see previewAdapter.ts); do not treat the absence of success toasts as a bug.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced. Initial test run showed 4 'failures' (photos-allow-all, desktop messages conversations, Ctrl+K palette, preview-lab-button) that were test-harness artefacts caused by page.goto() reloading the SPA and losing the non-persisted session state. Re-running the same assertions with in-app click navigation yielded 100% pass.
